metadata.description: Questionnaire family for psychosocial working conditions, demands, resources, leadership, and wellbeing.
metadata.intended_use: Occupational health, organizational development, employee surveys, and psychosocial risk assessment.
metadata.development_history: Developed as a multidimensional occupational-health questionnaire and adapted for national versions including German use.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Work demands, influence, social relations, leadership, and health-related outcomes interact in psychosocial work environments.
metadata.interpretation_notes: Use the selected German COPSOQ version and benchmark guidance; results describe working conditions and do not diagnose individual mental disorders.

versions.source_citation: Kristensen et al. (2005). The Copenhagen Psychosocial Questionnaire: a tool for the assessment and improvement of the psychosocial work environment.

source_documents.title: COPSOQ German source and questionnaire information
source_documents.license_name: Metadata reference; exact German edition and reuse terms require source review
source_documents.permission_basis: Only discovery and bibliographic metadata is stored. Item wording and forms are excluded until the exact German version and reuse terms are verified.
